summary: T3 Defense Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 2.01 completing the acquisition of 60% of Project 35, an Israeli defense supplier, for 21,059,871 shares of common stock and a $1,250,000 promissory note (12% interest, due July 5, 2027). T3 also commits to invest $2,500,000 in Project 35 over 12 months. The seller is X S.A. Security and Defense Ltd. No board recommendation, fairness opinion, or advisor is named. The deal adds unmanned aerial and counter-drone systems. No premium or closing date is disclosed; regulatory approvals are not mentioned. Watch for integration updates and the additional capital commitment.
